local_trace_definition: Mean of two finite-element gradient current traces. Their difference is a local discretization diagnostic, not an electrode-reaction error.
local_units: V in V; axis coordinates and lengths in mm; J in A/m^2; exchange in A/m of out-of-plane thickness.

local_endcap_definition: Actual finite endcap area averages; no point-tip substitution.
local_interpretation: Closed ellipse net flux should approach zero with refinement. Good global reaction-current conservation does not imply equally precise local gradient-trace integrals. Axis samples are local current density, not total through-current.
local_normal_definition: Outward from the geometric ellipse, common analytic normal for up/down traces.
